evidence.reason: Left edit removes reminders.initialize() and changes the calendar argument from "work" to "benchmark", altering the contract with evaluate.
Right edit rebinds evaluate to reminderDelayV2, whose signature and behavior are not supplied, so compatibility with the new "benchmark" argument is unverified.
reminderQuote calls evaluate(minutes, multiplier, calendar) and is exercised by tests with "work"; a changed evaluate implementation could break this caller.
Tests assert evaluate(20,0.1,"work") > 0 and that evaluate(-1,0.1,"work") throws RangeError, which the merged behavior must still satisfy.
Test asserts scheduledDelay(40) > 0, so the merged scheduling path must still return a positive value.

result.userExplanation: 合并后 evaluate 的实现被替换为未提供的 reminderDelayV2，同时 scheduledDelay 改传 "benchmark" 并去掉了初始化，无法确认新实现是否兼容这些调用与测试。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/reminders.ts 的 evaluate 维护者确认 reminderDelayV2 是否接受 "benchmark" 日历参数、是否仍需初始化，并保持对负数分钟抛出 RangeError；若不兼容，应改回 reminderDelay 或同步调整 src/scheduling.ts#scheduledDelay 的参数与初始化调用。
